result.summary: Found 2 minor visual issues: the category row is partially obscured at the right edge, and the bottom navigation is visually overlapped by the system home indicator.

issues.description: A partial category chip is visible at the far right of the category row, but it is clipped so heavily that it reads as an unintended stray grey shape rather than an available option.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal chip carousel has enough right padding or a clearer scroll affordance so the partially visible next chip looks intentional.

issues.description: The Android system home indicator overlaps the center of the bottom navigation bar, obscuring the search icon and creating a crowded, broken-looking footer.
issues.suggestion: Respect the device safe-area inset by adding bottom padding to the navigation bar or positioning it above the system navigation area.
